compute_hf_exchange_density: compute the Hartree-Fock exchange energy density on a grid for a PySCF molecule and density matrix
compute_screened_hf_density: compute the range-separated screened HF exchange density using an error function kernel with omega parameter
compute_coulomb_exchange_matrices: compute semi-numerical Coulomb and exchange matrices from HF density with grid weights for a molecule
compute_hf_density_derivatives: compute the first derivative of the HF exchange density with respect to the density matrix using fxx intermediates
create_hf_density_result: create an HFDensityResult container holding exchange energy density, fxx intermediates, and optional Coulomb and exchange matrices
